question: Whose own-nature delights in the devouring of the entire universe?
premises: There is a nature that delights in devouring the universe.
This nature is identified as that transcendent source.
It belongs to the supreme lord.
inference: The supreme lord's own-nature is the transcendent source that absorbs the universe.
plain_english: That is the own-nature of the supreme lord, delighting in the devouring of the universe.
